meroitic_place_classes.other: every other consonant, including h (freeze v2, cycle-2 section 6.1)

derivation_notes: ASJP classes from the codebook's articulatory definitions; E and 3 are vowel symbols (central vowels); N is the velar nasal (velar); 5 follows the pipeline's registered ASJP_MAP (5 -> s, coronal); 7 is the glottal stop and 8 the pharyngeal (other); y and j are palatal glides (other); w is the labial-velar glide (labial).
The tilde and double-quote are segment modifiers (nasalization; glottalization) in these lists, not segments, and spaces are separators; all three are dropped before classification.
Symbols observed in the 13 lists but absent from the table default to 'other' and are listed in asjp_defaulted_symbols.
